## What changes and why


## Checklist

- [ ] `build.cmd -Lint` runs without errors or warnings
- [ ] Tests: new behaviour has a test; `bin\eqlmaker-tests.exe` passes (say which tests were skipped and why)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see DCO.md)
- [ ] New files carry the SPDX header (`scripts\check-spdx.ps1`)
- [ ] Documentation is changed in English and German, code blocks identical (`scripts\check-docs.ps1`)
- [ ] `docs/status.json` is changed when a feature becomes available or changes its tests, and `scripts\update-status.ps1` was run
- [ ] No passwords, no personal data, no recordings of real applications
